locator: I q.3 a.5 co., second proof: nulla autem differentia posset inveniri, quae esset extra ens; quia non ens non potest esse differentia
interpretation: Read as: no differentia falls outside being, i.e. being is said of every differentia as belonging to what it is, because non-being cannot be a differentia. 'Outside' (extra) is taken in the same sense as in 'outside the essence of the genus' in the same sentence, which is what lets the two premises meet (DISAMB-PREDICATION-OF-DIFFERENTIA).
